core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mahir is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Skilled, expert, proficient”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mahir corresponds to the Arabic form ماهر (Arabic root م ه ر (m-h-r); مَاهِر (Māhir)). Its core sense is skilled, expert, proficient. Mahir is Arabic مَاهِر (Māhir) 'skilled, expert, proficient', from the root م ه ر (m-h-r). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave ماهير (a different form); the correct form is مَاهِر. The source gloss 'Skilled, Experienced' is consistent. Same name as maheer and maher.

persian.name: ماهر
